first_prompt: The following is the Codex agent history added since your last approval assessment. Continue the same review conversation. Treat the transcript delta, tool call arguments, tool results, retry reason,

commits.summary: Check boxed characters and object-array equality (verification pending)
commits.body:
Execute the selected JDK Character constructors, equality and hashes. Its ASCII cache preserves identity on symbolic inputs and its other factory branch follows the image. Inspect String.valueOf(char) allocation before returning a fresh one-unit String. Carry the initial line separator as one opaque reference, refusing its contents or external string identity. Execute the JDK reference-array equality and hashing methods and their element callbacks.

The focused JVM, interpreter and native controls passed on Temurin 21 and 25, including the cache boundary, isolated surrogate, nulls and a distinguishing pair. The changed suite exposed an old expected refusal for String results. Both the public echo proof and the altered-echo JVM counterexample passed after updating that assertion. Example 316 and pipeline schemas validated. Job 20261120-073837-check-immutable-csv-formats-through-boxe reruns the original six claims on the nine pairs of limits.

commits.summary: Prove hash contracts across JVM identity choices (verification pending)
commits.body:
Keep one unconstrained 32-bit identity hash per enum object while running the selected JDK hashCode cache. Equal objects keep their hash and different objects may collide. A possible assertion failure on a path that used an unspecified hash stays open. Execute Boolean and Long hashes from the image and resolve bounded symbolic integral factories only within their mandated cache.

Direct JVM, interpreter and native controls passed on Temurin 21 and 25. The native proof accepts stable hashes and refuses a demand for collision freedom. The changed suite exposed a static scan that still described the enum identity read as an unsupported call. Its focused interface test passed after the scan was aligned. A capped probe proved the original, nonvacuous CSV fix hash implication for all nine ordered pairs. Job 20261120-074513-verify-the-csv-equality-and-hash-contrac repeats all six original claims.

commits.summary: Execute live HashMap views on one JDK heap (verification pending)
commits.body:
Execute fresh default HashMap instances, entry nodes, key and entry views, and iterators from the selected runtime. Each view observes the same backing table and modification count. Keep observed and model-backed maps on their original layout and distinguish both bytecode bodies in cached frames. The interpreter also copies entries through the live iterator when a library method requests another map.

Temurin 21 and 25, the interpreter and native checker agreed on real bucket order opposite to insertion, colliding and null keys, replacement without invalidation, live setValue, remove, exhaustion and fail-fast behavior. A mixed HashMap and LinkedHashMap fixture exercised both representations. Strict probes proved the fixed original total and reproduced the parent defect on the 18-input domain. The changed tier passed 4/4 after one transient stand-in failure passed its automatic retry. Jobs 20261120-075403-verify-both-live-multiset-views-on-the-s, 20261120-075435-check-map-and-wrapper-conformance-under and 20261120-075443-confirm-jvm-corpus-hashes-and-map-outcom run the original packet and two cross-engine corpora.

commits.summary: Execute JDK reader and listener state (verification pending)
commits.body:
Run StringReader, BufferedReader, Swing listener lists, JavaBeans change support and iterator spliterators on their selected JDK bytecode. Preserve primitive class-mirror identity, instance checks, raw UTF-16 snapshots and proven-range bulk writes. Bind Collections.emptyList and its public field to the suppression sentinel only for the checked JDK initializer. Follow final reference fields across class initialization.

Temurin 21 and 25, the interpreter and native checker agreed on isolated surrogates, EOF, close, mark/reset, offset copies, listener removal, primitive mirrors and cursor effects. The values gate identified the two newly supported String operations and passed after adding their seven independent JVM samples and cache version. The historical CSV probe now reaches StreamSupport.stream. JFreeChart reaches TimeZone.getDefault in RegularTimePeriod before it constructs its explicitly UTC collection.

Original packet and regression jobs are 20261120-081134-trace-historical-chart-ranges-through-re, 20261120-081134-trace-both-csv-limit-readers-from-string, 20261120-081135-confirm-aliased-array-roots-after-librar, 20261120-081135-confirm-the-released-lcs-after-library-e, 20261120-081743-recheck-ordered-suppression-against-the and 20261120-081743-recheck-both-partial-date-revisions-alon.

commits.summary: Execute sequential JDK collectors on real iterators (verification pending)
commits.body:
Run the selected JDK stream flags, reference pipeline, collector and reduction on its actual spliterator and callbacks. EnumSet and EnumMap share the validated values-array snapshot. Void lambda bridges discard a returned value after its effects and check the instantiated argument types before entering the target. A solver failure that depends on a platform setting qualifies only if the failing paths cover all settings for fixed original scalar inputs. Execute ArrayList.clear and bounded StringBuilder truncation and zero-filled growth.

The native checker, interpreter and Temurin 21 and 25 agreed on an overridden forEachRemaining, null and repeated entries, one-shot stream consumption, erased callback casts, ignored category-two and constructor results, and erroneous enum initialization. A distinguishing empty-result assertion was refuted independently of JVM assertion configuration. The values corpus and its count test passed with the new operations. The changed acceptance run exposed an out-of-date 320 discovery index after result collection; regenerating it made the focused projection pass. Both original CSV row-limit probes proved all nine paired limits.

Job 20261120-083146-verify-all-csv-equality-hash-and-row-lim runs all six historic CSV obligations. The companion jobs are 20261120-083146-repeat-live-multiset-iterator-verdicts-o, 20261120-083146-repeat-the-real-duration-lexer-and-callb, 20261120-083146-repeat-lazy-optional-callback-and-eager, 20261120-083146-recheck-the-two-array-roots-after-sequen and 20261120-083147-recheck-published-lcs-source-and-release.

commits.summary: Record the real-map results and library boundary diagnostics
commits.body:
Import eleven canonical systemd results and their applied example evidence from the shared collector. Audited strict receipts decide four original CSV claims and all six Commons Collections multiset claims, including independent replays of both historical defects. The original 321 and 327 jobs locate their two different process-environment reads. Preserve the early mixed CSV jobs so each successful claim and each intermediate refusal remains available.

Both cross-engine proof-tier corpora passed. The reader checker requalified both poststate witnesses across the 71-heap regression and proved the released Commons Text score in 0.649 seconds at 80.7 MiB. The 225-item release and rebuild tables agree, and the shared-row mutant differs on 44. The regenerated example index passed offline acceptance, all affected examples validated, and the imported result bytes were checked against the collector.

commits.summary: Record 103 native decisions on the Java fast-follow examples
commits.body:
Close the original Commons CSV and Commons Collections multiset packets at their frozen guards, ordered classpaths, observers and bounds. On the final checker both have five proofs and one independently replayed historical counterexample. The parent CSV format compares limits 10 and 2 equal while reading three and two records. Removing A from a multiset containing one A and one B leaves the parent total at two although only B remains. Chart startup, Joda provider selection and the geometry sine retain 22 precise native obligations.

Re-audited all 125 original claim and subject pairs. The finite JVM route has 92 proofs and 33 refutations; native now has 76 proofs and 27 refutations, with no withdrawn or contradictory evidence. All 355 report links resolved. Compared 1,296 unique results and applied artifacts in the 17 new systemd jobs byte-for-byte with the collector. Twelve jobs passed, three early mixed CSV batches retained superseded diagnostics, and two calendar batches kept their current environmental blockers. All nine affected examples validated, including their public plans and offline discovery index.

The final checker reproduced both original 197 poststate witnesses on the 71-heap grids and proved the released 308 score in 0.628 s at 77.6 MiB peak process RSS, with all 225 release and rebuild cases correct and 44 shared-row mutant mismatches. The campaign report distinguishes per-claim process RSS from whole-packet cgroup peak memory, restores five previous measurements and records preparation as the dominant cost for both newly completed library packets. The verification queue is drained.
